Once again, sorry for taking too long.

EDIT: Oops, fixed duplicate page.

Funny story with this one. The original Fanza release didn't have a back cover, much to my dismay. Being a completionist (especially since I spent way too much time on the back cover last time), I started trying to reconstruct it using the tiny preview image for a few hours before giving up. For my next trick, I decided to DM Hitoi and ask if he could add the back cover to the release. And thank the stars, he actually responded to me and added the back cover, which you can see from the 1.1 update note on Fanza. In any case, since I went out of my way to bother him to do some extra work, I do feel a bit bad releasing this here for free, so please do support him by buying his work! It's only 770 yen, which is nothing!

I've included the textless cover as well, which actually has a slight edit to Konoha's pubic structure, though I kept the original art for the cover.

As far as random notes from me go, body writing is pretty fun and feels like interactive doujin reading. There was body writing in the previous work too, but that felt more like a chore because it had recording scan lines I had to recreate... This time it was just regular old writing. Such bliss.
